title: GreenTPA
description: A simple, high-performance TPA solution designed for modern Minecraft servers.
body:
## 🟢 GreenTPA v1.0

### ✨ Features
- Full TPA system
- /tpa, /tpahere, /tpaccept, /tpdeny
- Clickable chat buttons: [Accept] [Deny]
- Warmup teleport system
- Cooldown system
- Movement cancel protection
- Auto-accept system (/tpaauto)
- Toggle requests (/tptoggle)
- Ignore & block system
- Admin force teleport (/tpo, /tpohere)
- /back command
- Green themed messages
- Configurable via config.yml
- Custom messages via messages.yml

### ⚙️ Compatibility
- Paper 1.21.11
- Java 21
- Paper API

### 🛠️ Technical
- Optimized performance
- Clean event handling
- Async-safe logic

Thank you for using GreenTPA 💚
More updates coming soon!
